svg.text: High-Level Architecture, End-to-End Encryption & Offline Spool Pipeline
Recipient Offline → Route to Cassandra 30-Day Spool
Real-Time Delivery ACK (Double Gray Ticks) Routed Back to Sender
Ephemeral In-Transit Spool & Zero-Knowledge Security Architecture
Messages are strictly buffered in transit; once recipient emits Delivery ACK, encrypted payload is permanently deleted from servers.
Prekey Vault (Signal X3DH) enables asynchronous key negotiation even when the contact is offline, preserving forward secrecy.
2 Gray Checks: Delivered to device SQLite.
2 Blue Checks: Recipient opened chat view.
2. REQUEST SEQUENCE: ONLINE DELIVERY & OFFLINE SPOOL
4. Lookup recipient socket host in Redis Session Registry
5a. [Online Path] Inter-Gateway gRPC forward to Gateway B
6a. Downlink WebSocket packet to Recipient device (<100ms)
7a. Recipient delivers to SQLite → Emits Delivery ACK → 2 Gray Checkmarks
5b. [Offline Path] Write to Cassandra Spool with 30-Day TTL
6b. Trigger silent wakeup push notification (APNs / FCM)
7b. Reconnects, drains offline spool, and server permanently deletes rows
1. Ephemeral In-Transit Storage: Once a message is delivered and acknowledged, it is purged permanently from server disks, minimizing storage costs and ensuring user privacy.
2. Per-Conversation Monotonic Ordering: Avoid global distributed clocks; sequence generation scoped per chat room ensures strictly ordered delivery without cross-region locks.
Core Principles: Persistent WebSockets + Ephemeral Cassandra Spools + Redis Session Presence + Signal Protocol Double Ratchet
